results.text: I make crate sides, 400 mm long, 60 mm wide and 15 mm thick, supported at both ends. Each side has to carry 95 to 115 kg, and one side should weigh 320 to 360 g. This delivery is recycled HDPE from one supplier, fairly clean.
Make a shelf bracket, cantilever, 700 mm long, 40 mm wide and 12 mm thick. It needs to carry 18 to 22 kg and stiffness 4 to 6 N/mm. The plastic is recycled PETG.
Make a compression pallet block, 800 mm span, 120 mm wide and 90 mm thick, from rPETG. It needs strength 38-50 MPa and a weight under 35 kg.
Make a crate side, supported at both ends, 500 mm long, 50 mm wide and 10 mm thick, with a load capacity 95 to 115 kg, made from PP.
We make crates here - we get through 1.8 tonnes of crates a week. Make a crate panel 600 mm long, 80 mm wide and 12 mm thick from recycled PP.
Make a shelf board 900 mm long, 200 mm wide and 18 mm thick, supported at both ends. It sags about 10 mm under a person in the middle. Made from recycled HDPE.
